title: The card requirements are unresolved in the source
body_md: At this point the English source states requirements on the card that the German master of the **same edition** does not contain at all: a minimum requirement on the supported network standards and services, a note that the remaining credit cannot be checked over 4G, and an explicit prohibition of multi-operator SIM cards. The French version names yet another, differently worded recommendation. This manual therefore reproduces no card recommendation and no prohibition. Only a release by the manufacturer is binding.
prev_context: Before this stands the requirement for an activated nano SIM card.
next_context: The four-step preparation of the card follows.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 13: the box sits in the same place but carries different content. The difference is therefore a documented language difference of the source, not a reading error – and it is the finding that led to DSC-086. Provider names are omitted while DSC-027 is open.
